content: Colorado’s Award Winning DJ Service delivered once again at the wedding of Katie Lee and Michael Robertson! I arrived early in order to set up the sound system and the uplighting. When John arrived, I learned valuable lessons about appearance, timing, and constant communication with the bride and groom. As the night went on, it seemed as if the guests were not feeling like dancing too much, but when we changed the genre of the songs to a latin/ reggaeton feel, the dance floor became occupied again! The reception ended an hour earlier than planned, but things went smooth overall, and everyone was pleased with how the wedding turned out! – DJ Joel Jolly

We had a fairly early Rockies game and when it was finished we got hit with the after baseball crowd and didn’t leave! Knowing a late Friday night Denver crowd, I was expecting some hip-hop crowd, and played some of that music and quickly got more requests for country music! They loved it and danced all night long and the dance instructors were sure busy working th crowd helping everyone out! It was one of the best nights at the Saloon!

content: feel sorry for anyone who was not invited to Taylor Alexander’s graduation party. Despite some minor technical glitches, I was set up on time and ready to party before six o clock. As the party began, most guests went downstairs by the pool area. I knew that it was up to me to get the dancing going. For several songs, the only two dancers on the floor were Taylor’s grandma, and I. As more people came upstairs, more and more people began to dance. Near the end of the show most of the younger guests decided to get in the pool, and I was able to switch genres of music from Hip-Hop to classic rock. I received numerous compliments and I think it is safe to say that everyone had a great time. Colorado’s Award Winning DJ service delivered once again! -DJ Joel Jolly
